I was so excited to test it out so I want to leave some tips because everyone doesn't know how curing works believe it or not. So the lamp works, it is an LED lamp not UV so it's not harmful to your skin. It's cheap so it's a really good deal. How to Use: •There are two settings 30 & 60 seconds,

reviews.t: Great starter lamp for people getting into gel polish.
reviews.x: Why all the hate and bad reviews? This lamp is the price of a Chipotle burrito (for context). This is basically the same lamp that comes with the Madam Glam Gel Kit (which costs $35 if you buy it separately on Madam Glam, this one just doesn't have the cute designs on it).  I wanted to make sure I liked the gel polish system but I didn't want to spend a ton of money on a lamp until I knew I liked the gel system. This is nothing fancy: turn it on, it lights up for 60 seconds then turns off (30 se

This was my first time using LED top coats for my manicures and this little lamp exceeded my expectations.  Sets UV/LED polishes in seconds. It even speed-dried a variety of other "regular" nail polishes that I don't think were designed for use with LED light, (though it had no effect on others.)  I am very pleased that there is an alternative to harmful UV lamps.

reviews.t: Spend more on a proper light
reviews.x: Did not work properly. Began to smoke after the second hand. I am returning.

Great purchase, it's very small. Can't fit my entire hand,  have to do my thumb separately,  but I sure don't mind.  The sun cord it's not that long. I'm happy with the price I paid,  also arrived before expected time.
Terrible. Put my nails under it for 3 full minutes and still wasn't dry. Waste of money.

reviews.t: they dry super quick. I normally do the fingers first and ...
reviews.x: Might be a bit tiny, but it works amazingly! Depending on what gels you use, they dry super quick. I normally do the fingers first and then the thumbs together. It is a bit tedious but it's a mini lamp so you can't really expect much more for it. Easy to pack away and set up. If you want to gel your toes, it is wide enough to be able to put your foot under it. Does a great job, gels don't peel off until I want them to.

This is really helpful for me since I suck at painting my nails and always smudge it before it drys. I really recommend this to people that have trouble with the same things  as me or have gel polish. The only downside to this is that its super small and the cord doesn't go very far and I have to sit on the ground to dry my nails. If you have a high outlet its great for that
Works great. Lightweight and easy for travel or home use. Definitely a great buy for the price!

reviews.t: It works....but it's not the best.
reviews.x: You get what you pay for. It's smaller in size and the cord it comes with is identically tiny, making it near impossible to sit at a table (or anywhere without a close socket or extension cord). The light randomly goes off (after 1 second, 5, or 30) so it makes to difficult to look away for even a second. Finally the product glitches and I have to twist the plug around to ensure it connects constantly (probably not the safest feature).

I love the design and that it is travel size. However, the cord is quite short. I plug it into my portable charger so I’m not squeezed next to a socket and that works great. I do have to push the button several times to get my nails to dry fully and sadly, because of its size, I can usually only dry up to 3 fingers at a time at most. But it still dries my nails much faster than without. For its price I think it’s a good deal.

This product is great and I recommend it for anyone who wants amazing nails for cheap. However I have one problem. When I put my nails in the lamp I felt a burning sensation from the bottom of my finger to the tip of my nail. I don't know if the lamp did this or if it was because I had liquid latex on. I tried without liquid latex and it still burned but only from half of my finger to my cuticle.

I wasn't totally sure what to expect when I first bought this LED lamp. I knew it was going to be small, but it is SOOO convenient and I love it! I can carry it around from room and room, it's lightweight and easy to use. I've tried with all different types of gel polishes and it works perfect!

reviews.t: You get what you pay for.
reviews.x: It takes too long to dry. i used base coat, color and top coat. It is 4x less powerful than the recommended 36W uv lamps sp expect to spend more time under the lamp. I will buy a 36W uv lamp later but this one is not bad for it's price. There are more expensive 9W lamps out there.

reviews.t: I wish it were wider so i could dry all ...
reviews.x: I wish it were wider so i could dry all of my nails at once. It's also very lightweight so it's hard to get it to sit still when the cord gets curly
Multiple dry cycles needed to fully dry gel polish. Works better when covered one side with a black shirt.

It’s a nice little light and definitely gets the job done. It even has an automatic 1 minute interval that it lights up for. It is really small though, so you kind of have to tilt your hand vertically to get all your nails in. And even then you still need to hold your thumb so that it faces up, otherwise it’s the only nails that doesn’t cure properly. I end up just doing them once on their own just to be safe. But for the price it’s worth it.

reviews.t: i guess i should of expected crap since i paid such a low price
reviews.x: it took about three weeks to get to me and when i finallycould makea decision on what nail color to chooseit didnt work at all...not only is this item defective but not eligable for retplacements or returns. i guess i should of expected crap since i paid such a low price , but still...whata bummer. DONT BUY THISSSS

My wife was so excited to start doing her own nails.  She chose this lamp to start which worked fine at first. It suddenly stopped working after a few weeks. I ended up buying her a SUN lamp of 24w with digital timer and hand sensor for a few more dollars and it’s much better quality.

reviews.t: but it works SO GOOD! for just using a couple times a month
reviews.x: I was skeptical because this is so small, but it works SO GOOD! for just using a couple times a month, it's perfect. Takes a little while because I have to do my thumb separate. But if you are not wanting to spend a lot of money on this- turn on a movie and it works out great.

It came on time, and works perfectly! I honestly had my doubts but they all went away when i plugged it in.  I definitely recommend it because its an awesome product! The cord is small and it didn't come with a base to plug it into the wall, but its still amazing!

reviews.t: The only thing I would warn about this product is ...
reviews.x: The only thing I would warn about this product is that the cord is only about 2 feet long. I had to plug the USB into my laptop just so I wouldn't have to sit on the floor next to the wall. If it weren't for the cord length, I would have given it 5 stars.

This little lamp is so cute. When I saw it was so little I did not think it could do the job but it did. I ordered another inexpensive lamp for back up in case this one quit. So far so good. Its a fun little to use so I like it.

reviews.t: Worked great but not for long.
reviews.x: Worked great the first few times I used it. My nails were dry and everything but it did short out after only a couple uses. Great for first trying out gel but would recommend getting a better quality lamp.

reviews.t: Save your money and buy one that is of better quality. I ended up throwing mine away because ...
reviews.x: It's a cheap product and doesn't work very well. Save your money and buy one that is of better quality. I ended up throwing mine away because it just takes up space and doesn't work correctly.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the lamp works well and dries gel polish quickly, especially for the low price.
A common complaint is that the lamp is very small, so users can only cure a few nails at a time and often have to do thumbs separately.
The power cord is frequently described as short, limiting where users can sit and sometimes requiring an extension cord or portable charger.
Some reviewers report performance problems, including polish not drying, the light turning off randomly, or the unit smoking.
Several reviewers note it is lightweight and easy to travel with or move around.
